courses.subject: AECT
courses.title: The Science and Practice of Creativity
courses.description: Explores the science and practice of creativity, especially how to spur innovation and creatively solve problems at the intersection of emerging technologies and arts practice.

courses.subject: AECT
courses.title: Creative Coding and Emerging Technologies
courses.description: Explores the role of emerging technologies in creative coding processes and allows students to deepen their computer programming knowledge while building computational art portfolio pieces.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level CS 1315 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CS 1301 Minimum Grade of D or Undergraduate Semester level CS 1371 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: AECT
courses.title: Storytelling Studio
courses.description: Introduces technologies, techniques, and creative practices related to storytelling across multiple media platforms. Students hone their voice, vision, and craft as storytellers for media technologies.

courses.subject: AECT
courses.title: Leaders in Progress and Service for the Creative Industries
courses.description: Introduces students to the creative industries and the evolving role of technology within arts and entertainment. Empowers students to explore industry-specific leadership challenges and opportunities.

courses.subject: AECT
courses.title: Visual Arts and Design Studio I
courses.description: An introduction to creative problem-solving and the design realization cycle through project-based design exercises that emphasize the role of representation.

courses.subject: AECT
courses.title: Sound for Artistic Expression
courses.description: Explores technologies and techniques used in digital sound, music production, and audio for entertainment media including motion picture, art installation, gaming, and immersive experience.

courses.subject: AECT
courses.title: History and Critique of Arts and Technology
courses.description: Explores critical frameworks for analyzing creative technologies, the way technologies intersect with creative methods and the history of technologies as they intersect with the arts.

courses.subject: AECT
courses.title: Visual Arts and Design Studio II
courses.description: A project-based course focused on technologies, techniques, and artistic design skills for creating compelling visual experiences within computer software and media applications.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level AECT 3000 Minimum Grade of D and Undergraduate Semester level AECT 1500 Minimum Grade of D and Undergraduate Semester level AECT 2000 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: AECT
courses.title: Worldbuilding Studio
courses.description: A collaborative, project-based course that combines emerging technologies, design, and storytelling to build worlds for transmedia projects, spherical narratives, and post-cinematic entertainment experiences.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level AECT 1500 Minimum Grade of D and Undergraduate Semester level AECT 2000 Minimum Grade of D and Undergraduate Semester level AECT 3000 Minimum Grade of D and Undergraduate Semester level AECT 3100 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: AECT
courses.title: Senior Capstone for Arts, Entertainment, and Creative Technologies I
courses.description: The first semester of the capstone studio course for Arts, Entertainment, and Creative Technologies.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level AECT 2000 Minimum Grade of D and Undergraduate Semester level AECT 3400 Minimum Grade of D and Undergraduate Semester level AECT 3500 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: AECT
courses.title: Senior Capstone for Arts, Entertainment, and Creative Technologies II
courses.description: The second semester of the capstone studio course for Arts, Entertainment, and Creative Technologies.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level AECT 4000 Minimum Grade of D
